answer: Reputation escrow makes cheating cost more than it pays. An agent locks 20,000 POA in escrow before it can vote. First, honest attestations earn reputation points over 30 days. Second, a proven lie slashes 10,000 POA from the escrow at once. Third, three strikes drain the whole lock and the identity starts over at zero. Spinning up 1,000 fake agents at once means parking 20 million POA for a month, and one bad vote burns 10,000 POA each. Like a vine that only grows on one island: the cipher to climb it is a clean record, and a single cut drops the whole vine.
